criteria.question: is sound's facilitation of the giant fiber's response to a near-threshold loom robust across a fixed grid of loom gains, not only at the one working point the A2 calibration chooses?

protocol.near_threshold_rule: a grid gain qualifies if its loom-alone GF response probability (point estimate) is <= near_threshold
protocol.child: benchmarks/auditory.py <trials_per_arm> <data_dir> per gain with FLYCNS_A2_ONLY=1, FLYCNS_A2_GAIN = the gain, FLYCNS_A2_TRIALS = trials_per_arm, FLYCNS_AUDITORY_OUT = results/a2_robustness/gain_<g>
protocol.arms: loom alone on seed BASE, loom + sound on seed BASE + 1 (BASE = LIFParams().seed); sound = the auditory JO types at 150 Hz during each 60 ms loom burst
protocol.statistic: P(GF | loom + sound) - P(GF | loom), Newcombe 1998 method 10 95% interval, recomputed from counts

RA2_facilitation_at_every_near_threshold.condition: the per-gain band is compared when at least one grid gain qualifies; with none, RA2 fails on the count part alone, which is a point and carries no band
RA2_facilitation_at_every_near_threshold.rule: PASS if at least 3 grid gains qualify as near-threshold (a count, scored on its value) AND at every qualifying gain the 95% interval on the difference lies above 0 (lower edge exclusive); FAIL if fewer than 3 qualify or any qualifying gain's interval lies at or below 0; else UNRESOLVED

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 15 spikes per loom (9.7 on average on the strongest-gain quartile).
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
